program_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text = '''from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] != 8:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            colored = [(y, x) for y, x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0, 8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            pr0 = min(y for y, x in colored)
            pr1 = max(y for y, x in colored)
            pc0 = min(x for y, x in colored)
            pc1 = max(x for y, x in colored)
            pattern = [grid[y][pc0:pc1+1] for y in range(pr0, pr1+1)]
            ph, pw = len(pattern), len(pattern[0])
            for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                    out[y][x] = pattern[(y-r0) % ph][(x-c0) % pw]
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(program_text)
print(program_path)
